verdict.gold_reason: Article 42(2) of Reg 2017/2195 limits allocation of cross-zonal capacity based on an economic efficiency analysis to 5% of the available capacity for energy exchange of the previous relevant calendar year between the bidding zones, or 10% of total installed technical capacity for new interconnectors.
